title: Branch Condition Unit
statement: Create a branch condition unit that asserts a taken signal when an 8-bit signed operand is zero or negative and a separate control bit indicates branch-if-negative. The unit supports conditional branching in a datapath. The output must be combinational.
module_signature: module branch_condition_unit(input signed [7:0] value, input branch_neg, output taken);
behavior: taken is 1 when branch_neg is 1 and value is zero or negative.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use registers or sequential state.
hint: Check the sign bit and zero condition only when branch_neg is asserted.
